title: Apply for a tobacco licence – individual
summary: This page explains how an individual business owner can apply for a retail and/or wholesale tobacco licence in NSW.
intro:
If your business sells tobacco products or non-tobacco smoking products in NSW, your premises must be licensed.

If you own the business as an individual, you can apply for a retail and/or wholesale licence on this page.

You need to submit a separate application for each premises and licence type.

All tobacco licences are valid for 12 months.

If your business is owned by a corporation, Apply for a tobacco licence – corporation.
who_can_apply: Must be the registered business owner.
Must hold a current Australian Business Number (ABN).
what_you_need: A National Police Check completed in the last 3 months (JPEG, JPG, PDF, or PNG format)

how_to_steps.text: Log in or create an account.

more_info.text: You must provide complete and truthful answers to all questions in this application. Under the Public Health (Tobacco) Act 2008, giving false or misleading information could impact your ability to hold a tobacco licence.
For more information visit Tobacco retailing laws in NSW.

faqs.a: Your premises must be licensed if your business sells tobacco products or non-tobacco smoking products in NSW.

faqs.q: How long is a tobacco licence valid for?
faqs.a: All tobacco licences are valid for 12 months.

faqs.q: What if my business is owned by a corporation?
faqs.a: If your business is owned by a corporation, you must apply using the dedicated corporate application page.
